CANYON SURGE

Drift. Boost. Jump. Wall-scrape. Carve the perfect line through the sunlit red-rock canyon. Every car is identical — only skill counts.

HOW TO PLAY

Keyboard: W/↑ gas · S/↓ brake/reverse · A D/← → steer · SPACE/Z drift/handbrake · SHIFT/E/X boost · Q/F item · C camera · BACKSPACE respawn · R restart · P/ESC pause.
Gamepad: stick steer · RT gas · LT brake · A drift · X boost · Y camera · B respawn · Start pause.
Touch: on-screen buttons (landscape).

Drifting and scraping walls charge the boost meter. Boost needs a charge — tap it early, it is buffered. Hit the ramp at speed to clear the gap; land smooth for bonus charge. Complete 3 laps.
